scope: Unbounded symbolic facts/providers and opaque provider states. Complete original dependency membership, corresponding actual/declared providers, continuously effective provider cuts and stable deterministic decoding imply one-step fact preservation. Fixture instantiation uses the ten original UMF dependency identities, not inferred physical bindings. Finite-history induction requires premises at every step.
limitations: Opaque state equality abstracts all rows, presence, nulls and column values; no PostgreSQL SQL, trigger, driver or semantic decoder refinement
Source/role/config cuts, authenticated issuer and actual mapping provenance are premises, not established by hashes
No authorization, mutation atomicity, disclosure, browser/package qualification or backend acceptance promotion
